site_area_sqm.formula: Geodesic area recomputation of provisional feature PROV-SITE-001
assumptions: The geometry is provisional and non-official.
The value is for repeatable QA only, not statutory or engineering use.

green_ratio.formula: Provisional green-space polygon area divided by provisional site-boundary area
assumptions: Both numerator and denominator are agent-maintained provisional geometry.
The value is non-official, non-field-verified and not an engineering measurement.

public_space_ratio.formula: Provisional public-space polygon area divided by provisional site-boundary area
assumptions: Both numerator and denominator are agent-maintained provisional geometry.
The value is non-official, non-field-verified and not an engineering measurement.
